title: Juniper and the Room
author: Emrys Crane
blurb: Bram Dunmore, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
